new_result.name: QFORM-BILATERAL-ABSOLUTE-ENERGY-NUCLEAR-TAIL-v1
new_result.statement: For symmetric E and disjoint original-coordinate banks I,J, with a_I=tr(P_I|E|P_I), a_J=tr(P_J|E|P_J), one has ||E[I,J]||_{S1}<=sqrt(a_I a_J), hence s_{p+1}(E[I,J])<=sqrt(a_I a_J)/(p+1), sharply for every p. Combining with the account02/B12 adaptive reserve theorem gives s_q(M0+L+E[I,J]+T)>=max_p[s_{q+r+p}(M0)-sqrt(a_I a_J)/(p+1)]-delta when rank L<=r and ||T||op<=delta.

profile_refinement: If mu^I_a,mu^J_b are eigenvalues of P_I|E|P_I,P_J|E|P_J, then s_{p+1}(E[I,J])<=min_{a+b=p+2}sqrt(mu^I_a mu^J_b).
remaining_implication: From bare s_3(A)>=1, force an original-coordinate cut with reserve plus low-rank large-mode footprint / small bilateral absolute energy, or route failure to an already-paid D5/ridge/grouped-bank/hub/localized-core/Schur branch.
